entries.en: The geologist held an amethystine fragment against the light.
entries.zh: 地质学家把一块紫水晶质的碎片对着光看。

entries.en: The teaching archive contains an anatomical illustration of ametria.
entries.zh: 教学档案中有一幅无子宫畸形的解剖图。

entries.en: The historical vision survey grouped several forms of ametropia together.
entries.zh: 这项历史视力调查将几种屈光异常归为一类。

entries.en: The workers began a sit-down strike inside the factory.
entries.zh: 工人们在工厂内开始了静坐罢工。

entries.en: The rushed repairs left the kitchen looking like a dog's dinner.
entries.zh: 仓促的修理让厨房看起来一团糟。

entries.en: The maritime museum displayed a log line beside a wooden reel.
entries.zh: 海事博物馆在一个木卷轴旁展出了一根计程绳。

entries.en: Long ago, this narrow lane led directly to the harbour.
entries.zh: 很久以前，这条狭窄的小巷直通港口。

entries.en: The historian quoted the obsolete label white slave from a nineteenth-century trafficking report.
entries.zh: 历史学家从一份十九世纪的人口贩卖报告中引用了“被卖为娼的妇女”这一过时称呼。

entries.en: The officers will seal off the damaged bridge until inspectors arrive.
entries.zh: 检查人员到达前，警员会封锁受损的桥梁。

entries.en: The storm clouds parted to reveal a patch of blue sky.
entries.zh: 暴风云散开，露出了一片蓝天。

entries.en: The optical model illustrates an ametropic eye beside a normally focused eye.
entries.zh: 光学模型展示了一只屈光不正的眼睛，旁边是一只正常聚焦的眼睛。

entries.en: The librarian's amiableness encouraged even shy visitors to ask questions.
entries.zh: 图书管理员的和蔼可亲甚至鼓励了害羞的访客提问。

entries.en: Their amicability surprised colleagues who remembered the bitter dispute.
entries.zh: 他们友善的相处令记得那场激烈争执的同事感到意外。

entries.en: A child filled the water pistol at the garden tap.
entries.zh: 一个孩子在花园水龙头处给玩具喷水枪灌水。

entries.en: The sales manager charged the hotel bill to an expense account.
entries.zh: 销售经理把酒店账单记在费用账户上。

entries.en: The argument over the trophy turned into a battle royal.
entries.zh: 围绕奖杯的争论演变成了一场混战。

entries.en: The passengers gathered on the main deck for the announcement.
entries.zh: 乘客们聚在主甲板上听公告。

entries.en: The diagram marks the electron's negative charge with a minus sign.
entries.zh: 示意图用减号标出了电子的负电荷。

entries.en: The tree farmer inspected the young pines after the storm.
entries.zh: 暴风雨过后，树农检查了幼松。

entries.en: The frontier diary mentions a vigilance man guarding the warehouse.
entries.zh: 这本边疆日记提到一名守卫仓库的自警团团员。

entries.en: The pharmacy museum preserves an empty bottle labelled amidopyrine.
entries.zh: 药学博物馆保存着一个标有氨基比林的空瓶。

entries.en: The crew secured the heavy crate amidship before departure.
entries.zh: 船员在出发前把沉重的板条箱固定在船中部。

entries.en: The judge's legal opinion explains why the earlier ruling was reversed.
entries.zh: 法官的法律意见书解释了为何撤销先前的裁决。

entries.en: The trade gap widened as imports rose faster than exports.
entries.zh: 由于进口增速快于出口，贸易逆差扩大了。

entries.en: The child prodigy performed a difficult concerto without a score.
entries.zh: 这位神童没有看乐谱就演奏了一首高难度协奏曲。

entries.en: The architect placed a support column beneath the long beam.
entries.zh: 建筑师在长梁下面设置了一根支承柱。

entries.en: The scanner records the outline of each physical object on the tray.
entries.zh: 扫描仪记录托盘上每个物体的轮廓。

entries.en: A commercial message interrupted the radio interview halfway through.
entries.zh: 一则商业广告在广播访谈进行到一半时插播了进来。

entries.en: The chemistry reference compares aminic compounds with their related amides.
entries.zh: 这本化学参考书比较了胺类化合物及其相关的酰胺。

entries.en: The training record includes laboratory findings associated with aminoaciduria.
entries.zh: 培训记录包含与氨基酸尿症相关的实验室检查结果。

entries.en: The historical formulary lists aminophylline in its respiratory medicine section.
entries.zh: 这本历史药物处方集在呼吸系统药物一节中列出了氨茶碱。

entries.en: The actor brushed face powder across the bridge of her nose.
entries.zh: 这位演员在鼻梁上刷了些香粉。

entries.en: A life buoy hung beside the ferry's rear gate.
entries.zh: 渡轮的后门旁挂着一个救生圈。

entries.en: The queue at the ticket window stretched across the lobby.
entries.zh: 售票窗口前的队伍一直排过大厅。

entries.en: The mayor promised to discuss the proposal in public.
entries.zh: 市长承诺公开讨论这项提案。

entries.en: The retail archive displays a charge plate from a department store.
entries.zh: 零售业档案展出了一块百货商店的赊货牌。

entries.en: The history lecture examined Britain's departure from the gold standard.
entries.zh: 历史讲座分析了英国脱离金本位制的经过。

entries.en: Please add the new editor to the distribution list.
entries.zh: 请把新编辑加入发送名单。

entries.en: The catalogue dates this aminopyrine advertisement to the early twentieth century.
entries.zh: 目录将这则氨基比林广告的年代定为二十世纪初。

entries.en: The simulated medication record includes an entry for amiodarone.
entries.zh: 模拟用药记录中有一条胺碘酮记录。

entries.en: The biology diagram contrasts amitosis with division involving a spindle.
entries.zh: 生物学示意图将无丝分裂与涉及纺锤体的分裂作了比较。

entries.en: The old wooden crate began to break apart during unloading.
entries.zh: 卸货时，旧木箱开始散架。

entries.en: Calling the quiet newcomer a cold fish seemed unfair.
entries.zh: 把这位安静的新来者称为冷冰冰的人似乎不公平。

entries.en: A cracked coffee cup stood beside the open notebook.
entries.zh: 一本摊开的笔记本旁放着一个有裂纹的咖啡杯。

entries.en: The pudding arrived with a generous spoonful of hard sauce.
entries.zh: 布丁端上来时配了一大勺甜黄油沙司。

entries.en: The aviation exhibit includes footage of a wartime power dive.
entries.zh: 航空展收录了一段战时带油门俯冲的影像。

entries.en: The lecturer labelled the illustrated division as amitotic.
entries.zh: 讲师将图中的分裂标为无丝分裂。

entries.en: The archive contains an early manufacturer's leaflet about amitriptyline.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份厂家早期介绍阿米替林的宣传单。

entries.en: The chemistry table groups the ammino complexes by metal centre.
entries.zh: 化学表格按照金属中心对氨络配合物进行分组。

entries.en: The engineer traced the trunk line between the two telephone exchanges.
entries.zh: 工程师追查了两个电话交换局之间的中继线。

entries.en: The legal history seminar examined a petition for a writ of mandamus.
entries.zh: 法律史研讨课分析了一份请求签发职务执行令的申请。

entries.en: The parochial school shared its playground with the neighbouring church.
entries.zh: 这所教区附属学校与邻近的教堂共用操场。

entries.en: A clean face cloth lay folded beside the basin.
entries.zh: 洗脸盆旁叠放着一块干净的洗脸方巾。

entries.en: The employee handbook describes the company's retirement plan.
entries.zh: 员工手册介绍了公司的退休金计划。

entries.en: The bored guest tried to sneak away before dessert.
entries.zh: 那位感到无聊的客人试图在甜点上桌前偷偷离开。

entries.en: The assembly plant receives engines from a factory across town.
entries.zh: 这家装配厂从城另一头的一家工厂接收发动机。

entries.en: The historical chemistry manual describes the sample as ammoniac.
entries.zh: 这本历史化学手册将该样品描述为含氨的。

entries.en: The laboratory inventory records an ammoniacal solution in a sealed container.
entries.zh: 实验室清单记载有一份装在密封容器中的氨性溶液。

entries.en: The archived industrial protocol used specialized equipment to ammoniate the material.
entries.zh: 存档的工业操作规程使用专用设备对该材料作加氨处理。

entries.en: The investigator compared the false return with the company's original accounts.
entries.zh: 调查员把虚假的纳税申报表与公司原始账目作了比较。

entries.en: Several sharp rocks jut out above the shallow water.
entries.zh: 几块尖利的岩石伸出浅水水面。

entries.en: The report identifies the lender as a member bank of the Federal Reserve.
entries.zh: 报告指出，这家贷款机构是联邦储备系统的会员银行。

entries.en: Voters selected the party's candidate through a direct primary.
entries.zh: 选民通过直接初选选出了该党的候选人。

entries.en: The conservator inspected the telescope's object glass for scratches.
entries.zh: 文物修复员检查了望远镜物镜是否有划痕。

entries.en: The band set a brisk tempo for the quick march.
entries.zh: 乐队为齐步行进奏出了轻快的节拍。

entries.en: The coach gave a chalk talk before the players entered the court.
entries.zh: 球员上场前，教练用粉笔板作了战术讲解。

entries.en: The industrial archive contains diagrams of an ammonification chamber.
entries.zh: 工业档案中有一间加氨处理室的示意图。

entries.en: The old laboratory protocol used a sealed apparatus to ammonify the sample.
entries.zh: 旧实验室操作规程使用密闭装置对样品作氨化处理。

entries.en: The geologist photographed ammonitic fossils embedded in the limestone.
entries.zh: 地质学家拍摄了嵌在石灰岩中的菊石化石。

entries.en: The operating system moved the page into real storage.
entries.zh: 操作系统把该页移入了实存储器。

entries.en: The diplomat hoped the buffer country would remain neutral.
entries.zh: 这位外交官希望这个缓冲国保持中立。

entries.en: The document's new name appeared in the title bar.
entries.zh: 文档的新名称出现在标题栏中。

entries.en: The shop recorded its receipts on a cash basis.
entries.zh: 这家店按现金制记录收款。

entries.en: The technician tested the heater's safety feature before reconnecting the power.
entries.zh: 重新接通电源之前，技术员测试了加热器的安全装置。

entries.en: The spectroscope revealed a line spectrum rather than a continuous band.
entries.zh: 分光镜显示出的是线状谱，而不是连续光带。

entries.en: The historical case index includes two entries under ammoniuria.
entries.zh: 历史病例索引在氨尿症项下列有两条记录。

entries.en: The fossil collector found an ammonoid in the fallen limestone block.
entries.zh: 化石收藏者在掉落的石灰岩块中发现了一枚菊石。

entries.en: The fictional case follows an amnesic traveller searching for familiar places.
entries.zh: 这则虚构病例讲述了一位记忆缺失的旅行者寻找熟悉地方的经历。

entries.en: The astronomer measured the shift of a single spectrum line.
entries.zh: 天文学家测量了一条光谱线的偏移。

entries.en: She paused to blink away tears before reading the final paragraph.
entries.zh: 她停下来眨去泪水，然后读最后一段。

entries.en: The bank's letter confirmed the repayment schedule for the personal loan.
entries.zh: 银行的信确认了这笔个人贷款的还款安排。

entries.en: The workshop's golden rule was to measure everything twice.
entries.zh: 车间的指导原则是所有东西都测量两遍。

entries.meaningZh: 执行遗产事宜的私人代表
entries.en: The personal representative collected the estate's outstanding debts.
entries.zh: 遗产代理人收回了尚未偿付给遗产的欠款。

entries.en: The solid-state physics seminar focused on electrical conduction in crystals.
entries.zh: 固态物理学研讨课重点讨论了晶体中的导电现象。

entries.en: The designer chose light brown for the cabinet doors.
entries.zh: 设计师为橱柜门选择了浅棕色。

entries.en: The archived case summary describes an amnestic episode after the accident.
entries.zh: 存档病例摘要描述了事故后的一次遗忘发作。

entries.en: The embryology diagram identifies the amnionic membrane with a dotted outline.
entries.zh: 胚胎学示意图用虚线轮廓标出了羊膜。

entries.en: The animation shows a hormone binding to a receptor on its target cell.
entries.zh: 动画展示了一种激素与其靶细胞上的受体结合的过程。

entries.en: The memoir describes investors' confidence during the long bull market.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录描述了长期牛市中投资者的信心。

entries.en: The fictional investigation centres on an email containing insider information.
entries.zh: 这起虚构调查的核心是一封含有内幕消息的电子邮件。

entries.en: The supplier checked the quantities against the purchase order.
entries.zh: 供应商根据采购订单核对了数量。

entries.en: The power loom dominated the centre of the textile museum.
entries.zh: 动力织布机占据了纺织博物馆的中央位置。

entries.en: The former journalist entered the political arena after years of reporting.
entries.zh: 这位前记者在从事报道工作多年后进入了政治舞台。

entries.en: The historical drug register contains a separate entry for amobarbital.
entries.zh: 历史药品登记册为异戊巴比妥单列了一项。

entries.en: The biology animation shows amoeban movement across a glass surface.
entries.zh: 生物学动画展示了阿米巴在玻璃表面的运动。

entries.en: The public health archive includes an early survey of amoebiasis.
entries.zh: 公共卫生档案中有一项早期的阿米巴病调查。

entries.en: The materials table lists the modulus of rigidity for each alloy.
entries.zh: 材料表列出了每种合金的刚性模量。

entries.en: The lecture used diffraction patterns to introduce the wave theory of light.
entries.zh: 讲座用衍射图样引入了光的波动说。

entries.en: The file name extension changed when the image was exported.
entries.zh: 图像导出时，文件名扩展名发生了变化。

entries.en: The concert poster gives Sunday as the rain date.
entries.zh: 音乐会海报将周日列为遇雨延期的备用日期。

entries.en: The costume designer selected a leather half boot for the character.
entries.zh: 服装设计师为这个角色选了一只皮质半长统靴。

entries.en: The test pilot described the prototype's handling in a recorded interview.
entries.zh: 试飞员在录音访谈中描述了原型机的操纵性能。

entries.en: The old epidemiological table records reported cases of amoebiosis by district.
entries.zh: 这张旧流行病学表格按地区记录了报告的变形虫症病例。

entries.en: An amoeboid outline emerged as the animated cell changed shape.
entries.zh: 动画中的细胞改变形状时，呈现出似变形虫的轮廓。

entries.en: The music lover rarely missed a concert at the town hall.
entries.zh: 这位音乐发烧友很少错过市政厅的音乐会。

entries.en: The engineering drawings use the metric system throughout.
entries.zh: 这些工程图纸全部使用公制。

entries.en: The health education archive includes a poster about safe sex.
entries.zh: 健康教育档案中有一张关于安全性交的海报。

entries.en: Her mother wit helped her spot the flaw in the bargain.
entries.zh: 她天生的聪明才智帮助她发现了这笔交易的漏洞。

entries.en: The diagram shows a transmission line linking the two substations.
entries.zh: 示意图展示了一条连接两个变电站的传输线。

entries.en: The cargo remained in the free port before being shipped onward.
entries.zh: 这批货物在继续转运前存放在自由港。

entries.en: Leaves can stop up the drain after a heavy storm.
entries.zh: 大暴雨后，树叶可能堵住排水管。

entries.en: The commentary attributes this interpretation of the Mishnah to an amora.
entries.zh: 这部评注将对《密西拿》的这一解释归于一位阿莫拉。

entries.en: The philosophy seminar debated the assumptions underlying amoralism.
entries.zh: 哲学研讨课讨论了非道德论所依据的假设。

entries.en: The nineteenth-century newspaper printed a daily report from the police court.
entries.zh: 这份十九世纪报纸每天刊登治安法庭的报道。

entries.en: Cloud cover increased during the afternoon, gradually hiding the blue sky.
entries.zh: 下午云量增加，逐渐遮住了蓝天。

entries.en: The referee investigated allegations of foul play during the match.
entries.zh: 裁判调查了比赛中存在不公平行为的指控。

entries.en: The runner stopped at a water fountain beside the path.
entries.zh: 跑步者在小路旁的饮水器处停了下来。

entries.en: The warehouse stored food grain in carefully labelled sacks.
entries.zh: 仓库用标记清楚的袋子储存粮食。

entries.en: The real estate agent unlocked the empty house for us.
entries.zh: 房地产经纪人为我们打开了空房子的锁。

entries.en: The casebook reproduces a nineteenth-century writ of certiorari.
entries.zh: 案例汇编收录了一份十九世纪的复审令。

entries.en: The reviewer admired the young amorist's first collection of love stories.
entries.zh: 评论者很欣赏这位年轻言情作家的第一部爱情故事集。

entries.en: Please add up the receipts before filing the expense report.
entries.zh: 提交费用报告前，请合计这些收据的金额。

entries.en: The public prosecutor questioned the witness about the missing records.
entries.zh: 公诉人就遗失的记录询问了证人。

entries.meaningZh: 自称能用测水杖发现地下水源的人
entries.en: The village chronicle describes a water witch carrying a forked branch.
entries.zh: 村庄编年史描述了一位拿着分叉树枝的测水者。

entries.en: The ethics seminar examined a fictional case involving a brain dead patient.
entries.zh: 伦理研讨课分析了一则涉及脑死亡患者的虚构案例。

entries.en: The committee gave the unwelcome visitor the cold shoulder.
entries.zh: 委员会冷淡地对待了这位不受欢迎的访客。

entries.en: The planning map shows ribbon development along the old coastal road.
entries.zh: 规划图展示了沿旧海岸公路形成的带状建筑。

entries.en: The editor will cull out the strongest photographs for the cover.
entries.zh: 编辑将选出最出色的照片用于封面。

entries.en: The villain gazed amorously at the singer during the banquet scene.
entries.zh: 在宴会场景中，反派好色地凝视着歌手。

entries.en: The old poem leaves its defeated knight silent and amort.
entries.zh: 这首旧诗让战败的骑士沉默而意志消沉。

entries.en: The exhibition traces the early development of civilian atomic power.
entries.zh: 展览追溯了民用原子能的早期发展。

entries.en: The crisp fried fish ball broke apart under the fork.
entries.zh: 酥脆的炸鱼丸在叉子下裂开了。

entries.en: The mechanic checked the cruise control during the inspection.
entries.zh: 机械师在检修时检查了巡航控制装置。

entries.en: A skull and crossbones marked the old poison bottle.
entries.zh: 旧毒药瓶上标着骷髅图。

entries.en: The annual report lists the pension fund's administrative expenses.
entries.zh: 年度报告列出了退休基金的管理费用。

entries.en: They make no bones about their dislike of the proposed design.
entries.zh: 他们毫无顾忌地承认自己不喜欢拟议的设计。

entries.en: The contract includes a detailed schedule for amortisation of the debt.
entries.zh: 合同列有详细的债务分期偿还计划。

entries.en: The worksheet converts each ampere-hour into coulombs.
entries.zh: 练习题把每安培小时换算为库仑。

entries.en: The instructor expressed the transferred charge as one ampere-minute.
entries.zh: 教师将所转移的电荷表示为一安培分钟。

entries.en: The survey asked each unemployed person about previous work experience.
entries.zh: 调查询问了每位失业者以往的工作经历。

entries.meaningZh: 从事救济事业的工作者

entries.zh: 一位社会福利工作者帮助这家人完成了住房申请。

entries.en: The shop moved the pet food to a lower shelf.
entries.zh: 商店把宠物食品移到了较低的架子上。

entries.en: The recruits were told to fall in beside the flagpole.
entries.zh: 新兵们接到命令，在旗杆旁列队集合。

entries.en: Their compact car fitted easily into the narrow parking space.
entries.zh: 他们的小型汽车轻松停进了狭窄的车位。

entries.en: After the deadline passed, everyone began to mellow out.
entries.zh: 截止时间过去后，大家开始放松下来。

entries.en: The institute launched a crash program to restore the damaged archive.
entries.zh: 研究所启动了一项紧急计划，修复受损的档案。

entries.en: The physics worksheet equates one ampere-second with one coulomb.
entries.zh: 物理练习题把一安秒与一库仑画上等号。

entries.en: The calculation expresses magnetomotive force in ampere-turn units.
entries.zh: 该计算用安匝作为磁动势的单位。

entries.zh: 生物学图表将幼时水生而成体陆生的昆虫与完全水生的物种作了比较。

entries.zh: 对立双方的队长同意先共餐，再讨论条件。

entries.en: The toddler managed to cross the room without falling down.
entries.zh: 幼儿成功走过了房间，没有跌倒。

entries.en: The exhibition explores youth culture through music posters and clothing.
entries.zh: 展览通过音乐海报和服装探讨青年文化。

entries.en: The campaign may fall short of its fundraising target.
entries.zh: 这场活动可能达不到筹款目标。

entries.en: The second banana timed each puzzled look to support the comedian's jokes.
entries.zh: 配角滑稽演员精确把握每个困惑表情的时机，来配合喜剧演员的笑话。

entries.en: The charter changed the legal status of the settlement.
entries.zh: 这份特许状改变了该定居点的法律地位。

entries.en: The experiment measured the threshold level at which the tone became audible.
entries.zh: 实验测量了声音刚好能被听到时的阈电平。

entries.en: The editor removed an amphibology that made the subject unclear.
entries.zh: 编辑删去了一个导致主语不明确的歧义句式。

entries.en: The disputed contract contains an amphiboly involving two possible antecedents.
entries.zh: 这份有争议的合同含有一处涉及两个可能先行词的歧义。

entries.en: The poet marked an amphibrach in the second line.
entries.zh: 诗人在第二行标出了一处短长短格。

entries.en: The fashion model adjusted her jacket before stepping onto the runway.
entries.zh: 这位女时装模特走上伸展台之前整理了外套。

entries.en: The menu separates red meat from poultry and fish.
entries.zh: 菜单将红肉与禽肉和鱼类分开列出。

entries.en: The first repair estimate gave the optimistic owners a reality check.
entries.zh: 第一份维修报价给乐观的业主们提了个醒，让他们面对现实。

entries.en: The museum catalogue identifies the damaged object as a heavy weapon.
entries.zh: 博物馆目录将这件受损物品认定为一件重武器。

entries.en: The maritime drawing shows a fore-and-aft sail on the smaller mast.
entries.zh: 航海绘图显示较小的桅杆上装有一面纵帆。

entries.en: The train station stands opposite the town's oldest hotel.
entries.zh: 火车站位于镇上最古老的酒店对面。

entries.en: The historian mapped the member states of an ancient Greek amphictyony.
entries.zh: 历史学家绘图标出了一个古希腊近邻同盟的成员邦。

entries.en: The genetics diagram represents amphidiploidy with two chromosome sets from each parent species.
entries.zh: 遗传学示意图用来自每个亲本物种的两套染色体表示双二倍性。

entries.en: The magazine printed an amphigory full of invented birds and impossible rhymes.
entries.zh: 杂志刊登了一篇充满虚构鸟类和荒诞韵脚的滑稽无意义文章。

entries.en: The desk phone rang just as the meeting began.
entries.zh: 会议刚开始，台式电话就响了。

entries.en: The cutaway model reveals the lift's hydraulic system.
entries.zh: 剖面模型展示了升降机的液压系统。

entries.en: Please speak up so the people at the back can hear.
entries.zh: 请说大声些，让后面的人能听见。

entries.en: The cook added chicken stock to the simmering rice.
entries.zh: 厨师往正在炖煮的米饭里加入了鸡汤。

entries.en: A new bridge carries the trunk road across the valley.
entries.zh: 一座新桥承载着横跨山谷的干道。

entries.en: A sudden gust made the small boat turn turtle.
entries.zh: 一阵突如其来的风使小船倾覆了。

entries.en: The thermal image revealed a hot spot near the motor.
entries.zh: 热成像图显示电机附近有一处过热点。

entries.en: The embryology lecture illustrates amphimixis with an animated fertilisation sequence.
entries.zh: 胚胎学讲座用一段受精过程动画说明两性融合。

entries.en: The chemistry exercise identifies water as an amphiprotic substance.
entries.zh: 化学习题指出，水是一种两性物质。

entries.en: The medieval illustration depicts an amphisbaena with a head at each end.
entries.zh: 这幅中世纪插图描绘了一条两端各有一个头的两头蛇。

entries.en: The sudden funding cut could snuff out the young orchestra's hopes.
entries.zh: 突然削减经费可能扼杀这支年轻乐团的希望。

entries.en: The experiment compares the specific heat of two metal samples.
entries.zh: 实验比较了两种金属样品的比热容。

entries.en: The fairy tale gives the silver ring a magical power.
entries.zh: 这个童话赋予了银戒指一种魔力。

entries.en: The painter held the brush in her right hand.
entries.zh: 这位画家用右手握着画笔。

entries.en: The gardeners will grub out the dead shrubs next week.
entries.zh: 园丁们下周将把枯死的灌木连根挖出。

entries.en: The guest room has a double bed beneath the window.
entries.zh: 客房里窗户下方有一张双人床。

entries.en: The night porter handed us the key after midnight.
entries.zh: 午夜过后，夜间门房把钥匙交给了我们。
